# hibob_employees (Data Source)

Fetches the list of employees.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `employees` (Attributes List) List of employees. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--employees))

<a id="nestedatt--employees"></a>
### Nested Schema for `employees`

Read-Only:

- `company_id` (String) Id of the company assigned to the employee
- `creation_datetime` (String) Timestamp of inital creation of employee
- `display_name` (String) Name displayed for employee used for searches, etc
- `email` (String) Company email address
- `first_name` (String) First name of employee
- `full_name` (String) Full name of employee
- `id` (String) Employees ID within hibob
- `lifecycle_status` (String) Lifecycle stage of employee
- `second_name` (String) User chosen name (nickname)
- `status` (String) Status of employee
- `surname` (String) Surname of employee
